observations: Files actually read: the request JSON, the source page-7 lines, page-07.svg as text, and with Read I looked at main-cast.png, assets/panels/07-2.png, the neighbouring panels 07-1 and 07-3, and workflow/review/page-07.png.

Ravi's identity matches main-cast: thick straight brows set close to the eyes, warm slightly narrow eyes, a trimmed beard on a square jaw, a broad nose, short black side-parted hair and the light green shirt. He looks curious and hopeful, mouth open mid-question, and his gaze goes up and away to screen-right. That is the deliberate thinking glance the scene asks for, with Meera off-panel left.

Hands match production. His left hand (screen-right, wristwatch on this wrist) supports the lower right corner of the phone with the thumb along the screen edge. His right hand (screen-left) grips the left edge with the fingers wrapped behind and the thumb on the front bezel. Both hands have plausible fingers and joints, and no fingers merge into the phone.

The phone in its dark blue case faces the reader at chest height. The screen shows only a teal header wave, a card with a calendar icon and a blank pale-blue block, a card with a red heart icon and a blank mint block, and a bottom wave. There is no readable text, number or personal data.

Continuity: the dark-brown bag strap is visible over his left shoulder (screen-right), continuing from 07-1. The reception monitor (dark back only), keyboard and plant are in the left foreground, as the camera note asks. The seated patients behind him are small background extras who differ slightly from 07-1 (a grey-haired figure, a woman in pink, a man in blue), and the chairs are a bluer teal. That is minor, non-blocking background drift.

Label check in workflow/review/page-07.png: the 'WELBUK HEALTH for patients' label now sits mid-left (the SVG box spans about x 24-292, y 764-870). Its bottom edge ends just above the top finger of Ravi's gripping right hand, which starts at about y 876 and is now protected as [250,876,50,145]. Its right edge ends just left of the phone's case (protected box starting at x 297). On the rendered page I saw a thin band of background between the label and both the hand and the phone. The label touches neither hand nor the phone, and it no longer cuts the base of the phone-holding hand. The label covers only the background monitor, seated extras and part of Ravi's screen-left sleeve and shoulder. The gap is narrow, about 5-6 px, but it does not overlap. Ravi's face, his gaze and the speech-bubble tail are not covered.
